comment: List prices USD per million tokens, for cost ESTIMATES only (cost_usd_est in readings). Thinking tokens billed as output (industry standard). Entries carry confidence + asof; models without a verified list price are omitted and their cost renders null - estimates are never guesses. Cache discounts ignored (battery traffic is cache-cold by design). Update = ordinary PR; prices are config, not measurement. 2026-11-03 fill: every text model on the roster now carries a verified list price except sarvam-105b@sarvam (Sarvam lists it in INR only, Rs 15 in / Rs 60 out per 1M tokens; left null rather than convert at a guessed rate). jev@typesafe stays null (decision model, input-only pricing at $0.042/MTok with free output; its readings have no text-token cost model yet). Two old family-list guesses were wrong and are corrected: claude-opus-5 $15/$75 -> $5/$25 and claude-sonnet-5 $3/$15 -> $2/$10. Readings already published keep the estimate they were digested with; new prices apply from the next digest.
